description: Tidal Tomb as Logan Wolf went through it, played by the user: his first visit 2026-10-24 10:59:55-11:14:06 and four more that evening (19:32-21:04, capture 20261024_102346), and 2026-10-25 11:21:30-11:36:55 (capture 20261024_225113). The recall row 'Tidal Tomb Inside' lands on level 1 at (6653, 2097) beside a gold moongate; level 1 (x 6608-6738, y 1932-2109, z -24..85, 7,701 walkable tiles) is the hunting level here; level 2 (x 6817-6967, y 1909-2098, z -127..-10, 7,278 tiles) is the first underwater level, by a teleporter at (6718, 1984) or level 1's west strip (6608-6610, 2060); level 3 (x 7049-7255, y 1908-2221, z -55..3, 14,873 tiles) by level 2's north strip (6884-6885, 1929), its arrival (7162, 2221) 11 tiles from a Recovery Dolphin; Logan saw only its first part (x 7156-7217, y 2151-2221); the boss rooms weren't reached. Levels by a map flood fill (pathfind.Walk from each arrival; all of Logan's steps there walk on the map). The character's blocks come from the Mausoleum scenario (`inherit`). Merged at load time with tidal_tomb_kb.json (wiki stats, sim/kb_scan.py) and tidal_tomb_observed.json (the captures, sim/calibrate.py --scenario tidal_tomb).

oxygen.note: patch notes 2025-11-16 (knowledge #4641-4645): levels 2 and beyond are underwater; there players lose oxygen over time, leaving to level 1 or out of the dungeon refills it fully, so does a Recovery Dolphin 'every 5 seconds' for 'all nearby players'; the notes' 10 minutes to Minor Oxygen Deprivation (-5 hits, unpreventable, while above 66 %, each follower -5 % while above 66 %) and 20 to Major (-10 / -10 % while above 33 %). Live it took longer: 2026-10-24 Logan went under at 19:52:11 and 'You suffer minor oxygen deprivation.' came from 20:04:23 (732 s), 9 times 6.0 s apart (n=8 gaps 6.00-6.06), Logan -5 each until one -2 took him to the floor, a tidal mantis -32 five times, -7, then -1 three times (its regeneration above the floor): a hit never takes one below `above` (World._oxygen). The 'Oxygen' gump 0xEC5F8754 came every 6 s under water; its second bar's art stepped 28135 -> 28111 one every 30.25 s (24 steps to the deprivation), then the first bar started down (28134 at 20:04:23) [INFERENCE: major when the first bar runs out too, 24 more steps: after_s 1464; not reached]. Dolphin: 'Your oxygen is refilled.' (and '*oxygen refilled*' over us) 5.06-5.38 s apart while we stood near it (n=26 gaps, median 5.25), within 8 tiles of it (none at 10-13 tiles for 16 s and more); its tick's phase is unknown (the first refill came 0.5-2.3 s after we walked into range). Not modelled: the dolphin as a mobile (the runner never sees it), the gump. underwater: level 2's and level 3's boxes (flood fill)

spawn_note: one spawn per cluster of a type's first sightings (sim/calibrate.py creatures; sightings of a type within 5 tiles merged, the earliest kept). The first 68 come from the first visit (2026-10-24 10:59:55-11:14:06, levels 1-2): a first look, not the Mausoleum's 41-visit check. The other 58 come from the later visits (2026-10-24 19:32-21:04 and 2026-10-25 11:21-11:36), only where the first visit couldn't see (a first sighting more than 18 tiles from every tile it stood on), so a spawn it had isn't counted twice: 13 on level 1's middle, 39 on level 2's west and north, 6 on level 3's first part. Most first sightings came at 16-18 tiles (the view's edge): the spawn points are where they stood then. Left out: the pincer crabs that '*emerges*' beside a fight (specials 'dungeon-nest crab' brood; 30 in all), other players and their pets (notoriety 1), the red player (docs/NOTES.md 'Tidal Tomb'), the recovery dolphin (oxygen.dolphins), 5 monsters whose name never came. 2026-10-26: the user walked all of level 1 (capture 20261026_183552, 20:30-20:45, within 12 tiles of 96 % of its floor); 25 spawns added (86 on level 1 now), one per idle first sighting (not war mode, not '*emerges*') more than 8 tiles from every spawn of its type (spawn_spread 4 and the 2-tile wander keep a spawn's own monster within ~6): 24 of today's, mostly the west rooms (x 6620-6648) and the south-east room (x 6688-6723, y 2056-2094) that had none, and a nest crab of 2026-10-24 19:33:47 the old 18-tile rule had left out (the first visit had seen that spot). Two idle pincer crabs far from any nest crab or scavenger are spawns; three within 3 tiles of one are taken for broodlings. 6 of the 61 earlier level 1 spawns met nothing of their type within 6 tiles today, in view 16-97 s each: kept (a respawn or another player's kill explains that).
